label: MARKETING TERM
headline: The Customer Journey
body: This is the complete path a potential customer takes from first hearing about you to becoming a paying customer and beyond.
caption:
Understanding your customer's journey helps you see things from their perspective, so you can make their experience smoother and more helpful at every stage. Think about how someone finds your online store, what questions they have before buying, and how they feel after using your product or service.
